description:
**About Us**
 Morgan Stanley is building an industry\-leading digital banking and cash management platform that leverages cutting\-edge technology to provide clients with self\-service capabilities to manage their wealth and personal finances in one central location. We are embarking on a multi\-year growth plan to deepen engagement across all channels and enhance our Banking product offering.
   

  

 Our entrepreneurial Digital Platforms team is seeking a high\-performing Digital Banking Product Owner with a passion for building innovative technology, developing solutions to complex problems, and helping scale our platform.
   

  

 As a Product Owner, you will lead exciting technology initiatives to bring new products to market for both the Morgan Stanley and E\*TRADE client\-facing platforms across web and mobile. This is a highly collaborative role in which you will work closely with digital Product Managers and partner with cross\-functional teams including design, engineering, operations, legal, risk, compliance, fraud, and business stakeholders to transform the experience for our customers. You will help define and drive the digital product strategy and then develop, launch, and enhance the platform to meet customers' unique needs.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 \> Work in a fun, fast\-paced environment designing new and improved banking technology for clients (mobile apps, websites, embedded AI etc.).
   

  

 \> Design innovative new products with market\-leading competitive advantages that revolutionize how people manage and spend their money.
   

  

 \> Create a vision, strategy, and roadmap for digital banking product offerings.
   

  

 \> Deliver new products by partnering directly with technology, business, and operations teams to define and write requirements, manage the overall project plan, and execute deliverables.
   

  

 \> Lead client research, requirements development, and user experience design for new digital products.
   

  

 \> Support usability testing and translate findings into product improvements that drive increased adoption.
   

  

 \> Research and analyze the digital banking and wealth management industries, with a focus on cash management and digital payments.
   

  

 \> Present findings to executive management, and drive change execution aligned with Wealth Management priorities Experience
   

  

 \> 3\+ years of professional experience in wealth management, retail banking, and/or consumer financial technology.
   

  

 \> 3\+ years of professional experience in technology product management and design.
   

  

 \> Software development lifecycle experience preferred.
   

  

 \> BA/BS required; MBA (or advanced degree) preferred.
   

  

**Skills/Abilities**
 \> Deep understanding of web and mobile technologies
   

  

 \> Deep understanding of Retail Banking competitive landscape and emerging technologies
   

  

 \> Sharp focus on usability and design
   

  

 \> Excellent relationship building capabilities with internal and external partners
   

  

 \> Understanding of Banking business risk and control mechanisms
   

  

 \> Independent initiative and ability to operate in a fast paced environment
   

  

 \> Strong attention to detail in both technical and non\-technical capacity
   

  

 \> Strategic thinker able to define and evaluate alternatives, and translate goals into specific project tasks
   

  

 \> Excellent communicator with solid written and verbal presentation skills
   

  

 \> Solid business understanding to align product goals with organizational objectives
   

  

 \> Effective communication to collaborate and influence more junior team members and stakeholders
   

  

 \> Analytical skills to dive deep into data, identify trends, and inform product decisions.
   

  

 \> Technical proficiency to understand the development process and support implementation
   

  

 \> Problem\-solving ability to navigate challenges and refine solutions
   

  

 \> Team collaboration to work closely with cross\-functional teams and foster a productive environment.
   

  

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
   

  

 Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

 MeraDhan is an Online Bond Platform Provider (OBPP) making bond investing simple and accessible for Indian investors. We're looking for a Product Manager to own our platform end to end, from how investors discover bonds to how they place orders, pay, and track their portfolio.
 



 This is a hands\-on role at a startup. You'll work directly with business, tech, design, operations, and compliance, and your work will ship to real investors quickly.
 



  





 What you'll do
 


* **Own the roadmap:** 
 Turn business goals, investor needs, and market opportunities into prioritised features and releases for our bond platform.
* **Define the product:** 
 Write PRDs, user stories, user journeys, and acceptance criteria for flows such as bond discovery, onboarding and KYC, RFQ\-based order placement, payments, settlement tracking, and portfolio reporting. Maintain and prioritise the backlog.
* **Drive delivery:** 
 Coordinate across business, design, technology, operations, compliance, and external partners such as exchanges, clearing corporations, depositories, and KYC and payment providers to ship on time and with high quality.
* **Improve performance:** 
 Track investor feedback, usage analytics, operational metrics (for example, order and settlement success rates), and business KPIs, and recommend continuous improvements.
* **Keep us release\-ready and compliant:** 
 Lead UAT and release planning, manage risks and documentation, communicate with stakeholders, and make sure product changes meet SEBI and exchange requirements applicable to OBPPs.



  





  





 Who we're looking for
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 years in product management or business analysis. We'll give priority in this order:
 


1. **Strongly preferred:** 
 Experience at an OBPP, bond or fixed\-income platform, or on the debt desk, debt operations, or fixed\-income product team of a broker, bank, or wealth firm
2. **Also relevant:** 
 Stock broking, wealth management, mutual fund, or other investment platforms
3. **Open to:** 
 Other fintech or BFSI products, if you have strong product fundamentals and a genuine interest in fixed income



  





  





**Domain knowledge:** 



* Bond fundamentals such as coupon, yield to maturity, accrued interest, clean vs dirty price, and credit ratings
* How bond transactions work in India, including RFQ platforms, clearing and settlement, and depositories
* Digital investment journeys: onboarding, KYC, payments, order management, and portfolio reporting
* Working knowledge of SEBI and exchange regulations for OBPPs and stock brokers, or the ability to learn them quickly



  





**Product skills:** 
 Proven ability to build roadmaps, write PRDs and user stories, prioritise backlogs, design user journeys, and take products from concept to launch.
 



**Delivery:** 
 Experience working with engineering, UI/UX, operations, compliance, sales, and external partners in Agile teams.
 



**Mindset:** 
 Investor\-focused, data\-driven, and commercially aware, with strong stakeholder management, communication, and decision\-making skills.
 



**Preferred qualification:** 
 MBA or postgraduate degree in Management, Finance, or Technology, with a bachelor's in Engineering, Technology, Business, or a related field.
 



  





 Compensation
 



 The budgeted CTC for this role is
 **₹7–9 LPA** 
 . Please apply only if this range works for you.

 A six\-times certified ‘Great Place to work’ workplace, at FlexiLoans you will be working with top tier talent from diverse backgrounds hungry to make a dent in the MSME universe.
